newsitem.title: UK: Swissair targets young with MTV ads.
newsitem.headline: Swissair targets young with MTV ads.

text.p: Swissair, the Swiss airline, said on Wednesday it was targeting younger consumers through a new advertising campaign on MTV Europe.
The airline said it wanted to attract new customers such as young professionals and leisure travellers across Europe.
Blandine Pillot, media account manager at Swissair's ad agency, Young & Rubicam Europe, said the aim was "to address new customers through a fresh approach which sets us apart from the competition".
"We believe that our new agreement with MTV Europe will be instrumental in helping to achieve this goal," she said.
The ad campaign features bright, colourful images such as sunflowers and includes the endline "Swissair: the World's most refreshing airline".
The ad spots will run in MTV programmes including "MTV Unplugged" and "Live'N'Loud".
"Swissair will be breaking new ground by reaching the elusive youth market across Europe," said MTV's senior vice president of advertising sales Boris Kaz.
Many companies that advertise on MTV make products aimed at young people, but MTV said Swissair was not the first non-youth oriented brand to advertise on the channel.
"There are a number of companies who are using MTV that are not specifically youth brands such as retailer C&A," said a company spokeswoman.
MTV is available to 56 million homes and 176,000 hotel rooms throughout Europe.
No money figures were available on the new campaign.
